text.title: WebSocket Design Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the spec artefact this methodology produces. Validator in scripts/validate-websocket-design.py enforces required keys, enum bounds, and pattern constraints.

section.title: Schema

example.note: All required keys present; enums and patterns satisfied; the ticket TTL is inside the 5-minute ceiling and every message type carries a schema.

Forbidden traits: Missing fanout; heartbeat_seconds out of range; reconnect.strategy not const full_jitter_exponential; auth_ttl_seconds far beyond the 5-minute ceiling; no shed policy and no message schemas.

list.item: A raw JSON payload with no envelope — the client breaks on the first added field.
No application-level heartbeat — the connection looks alive client-side minutes after a NAT timeout dropped it.
Fixed-interval reconnect — after a restart every client returns inside the same window and takes the server down again.
An unbounded per-connection send queue, or a bounded one with no declared shed policy.
A message type with no JSON schema, or validation on only one side of the connection.
A close with no RFC 6455 code, or 1000 used for a policy violation.
A long-lived cookie or JWT as the sole handshake credential.

text.reference: JSON Schema for the envelope plus one example message type.
